review_process.parent: GPT-6 Astra; acquisition, source interpretation, integration and final source/diff review
review_process.independence: Correlated computational reviews with shared sources/context; not independent human review or laboratory validation. Source objections override agreement.

adjudications.objection: The discovery lead does not concern the MAL system.
adjudications.resolution: Close MAL applicability at E.coli TK identity; create a separate source-scoped TK-1/TK-2 relation, with no human-TKT2019 or MAL transfer.

adjudications.objection: Broad prose says no adverse activity impact while the fixed-concentration column is lower.
adjudications.resolution: Retain the lower reported central specific activity, uncertain apparent kcat and integer-displayed61% conversion as separate endpoints; no inferred intended endpoint, statistical significance or generic benefit label.

adjudications.objection: Apparent parameters have different substrate/temperature scope from conversion and prior6M.
adjudications.resolution: Bind21C current kinetics and25C24h peak-area conversion separately. kcat and KM retain their own SEM; central KM estimates exceed150mM tested upper bound. Prior6M varied pyruvate rather than3-FBA; no matched cross-study ratio or complete perturbation square.

adjudications.objection: Fixed-concentration activity may be calculated from the same kinetic curve.
adjudications.resolution: Keep origin/dependence unresolved. Project diagnostic evaluation of the printed central Vm and KM values closely matches the specific-activity column, which is consistent with shared-fit dependence without proving calculation history. No independent corroboration or source-value replacement.

adjudications.objection: Rounded implies an unreported rounding procedure.
adjudications.resolution: Use integer-displayed/source-reported61%; no conversion uncertainty, equivalence or raw time-course inference.

adjudications.objection: Exact assayed sequence, plasmid and product stereochemistry are absent or ambiguous.
adjudications.resolution: Retain full source mutation sets and incremental R520Q, His6 context and pQR791/pQR729 discrepancy without accession/sequence substitution. Product identity stays an author claim for four selected variants; underlying SI spectra, exact configuration and ee remain unassessed.

adjudications.objection: A second stored ratio would duplicate the common arithmetic.
adjudications.resolution: Source context identifies comparison/assay and numerator/denominator; the shared query computes the central ratio once.

blocked_operations: Matched6M/current-variant kinetic ratio or factorial epistasis
Statistical significance, equivalence or propagated ratio uncertainty
Exact assayed sequence/accession authentication or product stereochemical assignment
Elementary-step rate, productive docking geometry or isolated residue mechanism
Protein admission, frozen-kernel mutation, independent validation or design-performance claim
remaining_limits: Primary article and selected Table2/3 cells inspected; no supplementary spectra, raw fits, independent specimens or previous6M primary. Final publication-head review belongs in Git-local receipt.
